Growth in Alibaba Cloud’s recurring revenue from external customers was 67%, which drove an acceleration of overall cloud revenue growth with significantly improving profitability. We recently announced comprehensive upgrades spanning proprietary chips, supernode architecture, agent-native cloud infrastructure, AI models and agents.
